records.body: Does the API support pagination for the accounts endpoint, or do we need to fetch everything at once?

records.subject: Re: API pagination
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Thanks for your patience on this. List endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you won't need to pull everything in one call.

Thanks so much,
Tariq Diallo

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Silver Group
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Customer explicitly paused evaluation ("still deciding if this is the right tool... give it another week") [email:1901416e], day 6 with no project, no invite, no milestone, and an unresolved notification bug ticket (tick_381e317a7403) adding friction. 8 days left, but stated intent is to wait.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Thanks for being straight with me — take the time you need to decide, and I won't crowd you. Your note about the notification badge is still open with our team, and Tariq is on it.

If it helps your evaluation, I'm happy to walk through one thing with you: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so setting up a single real project is usually the fastest way to judge the fit. Want me to help you get that first one shaped this week?

Best,
Nadia
